name: TimePro
description: TimePro is a comprehensive grounding-centric instruction tuning dataset designed for long video understanding by Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). It includes 9 tasks and 349k high-quality grounded annotations, featuring a novel Temporal Grounded Caption task that requires detailed video descriptions with corresponding timestamps to improve temporal awareness and reduce hallucination.
reputation: A very recent instruction-tuning dataset that is gaining attention in the long-video MLLM community but is not yet widely established as a standard benchmark.
notes: Focuses on long video understanding with temporal grounding and instruction tuning; includes a new task type for temporal grounded captioning.
